name: payment-manual
description: A payment provider for bKash, Nagad, Rocket and bank transfers that staff confirm by hand.
removeWarnings: Manual payments already in the payments table survive this removal. Confirm or reject the submitted ones before you remove the provider: the core refuses to act on a payment whose provider is not registered.
The @repo/validators dependency stays in packages/payment/package.json. A package-json-dependency patch has no removal inverse, so drop the line by hand and run pnpm install.
